transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on the production plan for the next window. We have 240 Model X motor drives and 120 Model Y motor drives to plan for, but only 450 power modules currently released for use. Before I can sign off on any allocation, I need to walk through the status with each of you per our daily materials review process. Let's begin: can process engineering, quality, logistics, and product compliance each give me their current status and any constraints I need to be aware of? I also need to understand whether any of the power modules in the quality-hold area can be approved for recovery, and if so, how many. I will not sign any plan until I've verified both the released-module limit and any approved recovery limit.

transcript.text: I need to share an important update from my engineering bill-of-materials review. After the latest engineering change, I confirmed that each Model X drive requires exactly 2 power modules and each Model Y drive requires exactly 1 power module. I completed this review but have not yet entered the revised quantities in the planning system, so the system may still show outdated BOM data. This means our total module requirement for the full plan is 600 modules for Model X (240 × 2) plus 120 modules for Model Y (120 × 1), totaling 720 power modules. With only 450 currently released, we'd need 270 additional modules approved for recovery from quality-hold to fulfill the complete plan.

Thank you all for your inputs. Let me summarize what I now have before I can make any allocation decision:

1. **Ravi (PF1):** Each Model X requires 2 power modules, each Model Y requires 1. Total requirement for the full plan is 720 modules (480 for Model X + 120 for Model Y).

3. **Jon:** You mentioned you have customer confirmations with specific shipment timing that may allow phasing production across multiple shipment windows. However, you said 'Let me formally disclose this information now' — but you haven't yet actually shared the specific dates, quantities per shipment, or timing details. I need those specifics before I can structure a phased plan. Please share the exact shipment schedule now.

4. **Simone (PF4):** Model Y drives require serialized power-module traceability and a lot-specific compliance certificate before shipment. This is a compliance-gated condition I'll need to build into any Model Y disposition.

**Current arithmetic:** 450 released + 150 recoverable = 600 modules maximum available. Full plan requires 720. We're short by 120 modules, which means we cannot fulfill both orders in full unless Jon's shipment phasing information changes the picture.

Jon, I need you to share the actual shipment schedule details — dates and which quantities are required by when — so I can determine whether a phased plan is feasible and structure my disposition accordingly. I will not sign anything until I have that information and can verify all arithmetic limits.
